purpose: Display and operate on tabular data. Virtualized; holds its own sort, filter, search, selection, column and pagination state in an external store exposed through GridApi.

props.name: agent
props.description:
The agent that turns a sentence into grid operations, from
`useGridAgent`. `null` while none is in scope, and the box renders
nothing rather than offering something that cannot answer.

props.name: agentPolicy
props.description: Columns and operations withheld from whatever is driving the grid.

props.name: ai
props.description:
Render a natural-language box above the grid.

Needs a `<GramproAIProvider>` above it supplying an adapter; without one
this renders nothing and the grid is unchanged. No model is bundled or
downloaded — the application brings its own.

props.name: autoHeight
props.description: Grow to fit all rows instead of scrolling (use with pagination or small data).

props.name: columns
data
props.description:
The rows to show. One object per row, in whatever shape your data already
has — columns reach into it rather than the other way round. In `server`
mode this is the current page, not the whole set.

props.name: emptyState
props.description:
Shown in place of rows when there are none. Worth distinguishing "nothing
here yet" from "nothing matched your filters", which the default does not.

props.name: enableColumnHiding
props.description: Let columns be shown and hidden from the toolbar. Default `true`.

props.name: enableColumnPinning
props.description: Let a column be pinned to the left or right edge. Default `true`.

props.name: enableColumnReordering
props.description: Let a header be dragged to move the column. Default `true`.

props.name: enableColumnResizing
props.description: Let a header edge be dragged to resize. Default `true`.

props.name: enableFiltering
props.description: Per-column filters and the toolbar's search box. Default `true`.

props.name: enableMultiSort
props.description:
Let a shift-click add a column to the sort rather than replacing it.
Default `true`, and inert while `enableSorting` is off.

props.name: enablePagination
props.description: Page the rows instead of scrolling the whole set. Default `true`.

props.name: enableRowSelection
props.description:
Add the selection column. Default `false`. A function selects per row —
return `false` and that row's checkbox is disabled, which is how to stop
someone picking a record their role does not cover.

props.name: enableSorting
props.description: Let a header click sort the column. Default `true`.

props.name: exportFileName
props.description: Base name for an exported file, without the extension.

props.name: getRowClassName
props.signature: ((row: T, rowIndex: number) => string | undefined) | undefined
props.description: A class per row, for status colouring. Return undefined for no class.

props.name: getRowId
props.typeText: Extract<keyof T, string> | ((row: T, index: number) => RowId) | undefined
props.description:
Stable row id: a property name (recommended) or a function.
Defaults to `row.id`, falling back to the array index.

props.name: headerHeight
props.description: Fixed header height in px. Defaults to the density's row height.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scrolling area. Ignored with `autoHeight`. Default 520.

props.name: initialState
props.description:
Where the grid starts — a default sort, a page size, hidden columns. Read
once on mount and then owned by the grid, so later changes are ignored.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Show the loading treatment over the grid. The existing rows stay in place
underneath, so a refresh does not empty the screen.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for number and date formatting.

props.name: mode
props.description: `client`: the grid sorts, filters and paginates. `server`: `data` is the current page.
props.note: `client` lets the grid sort, filter and paginate. `server` means `data` is already the current page and the host answers `onQueryChange`.

props.name: onCellEdit
props.description:
A cell was edited. Fires only when the value actually changed.

Return a promise to make the edit optimistic: the new value shows while
it is in flight, and if the promise rejects the cell reverts to the
underlying data and shows the rejection's message as the cell's error.
So reject with the reason you want the user to read.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Fires when sorting, filters, search or pagination change.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Not fired for clicks on interactive content (buttons, inputs, links, checkboxes).

props.name: onRowDoubleClick
props.description: Same exclusions as `onRowClick`: interactive content does not reach it.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description:
Every change to sorting, filters, search, pagination, selection, column
layout or density, with the state before it for comparison. This is the
hook for persisting a user's view.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Page sizes offered in the pager. Default `[25, 50, 100, 250]`.

props.name: rowCount
props.description: Total rows on the server (server mode).

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Fixed row height in px. Defaults to the density's height.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: `single` leaves one row selected at a time. Default `multiple`.

props.name: semantics
props.description: What a machine cannot read off a column definition: units, synonyms, PII.

props.name: state
props.description:
Drive the grid from outside. Whatever you pass here the grid obeys rather
than deciding for itself, so pair it with `onStateChange` or the grid
stops responding. Pass only the slices you want to own; the rest stay
internal. For a starting point you do not intend to control, use
`initialState`.
props.note: Makes the grid controlled. Prefer `initialState` unless the host genuinely owns the state.

props.name: suggestions
props.description:
Example questions offered before anyone types. Worth setting to the
phrasings this data actually supports — they teach the shape of a good
question faster than placeholder text does.

props.name: toolbar
props.description:
The toolbar above the grid. `true` for all of it, `false` for none, or an
object to choose parts — `{ search: true, export: false }` — and to put
your own controls at its `start` or `end`.

supplied: WAI-ARIA grid pattern: role=row/rowgroup, aria-colindex, aria-rowindex
aria-multiselectable when row selection is enabled
full cell keyboard navigation, including the header row
required: aria-label on the grid when its purpose is not obvious from the page
a visible heading or caption nearby for screen-reader context

composition.notes: Self-contained. Columns are configuration, not children. Keep `data`, `columns` and `getRowId` referentially stable — the grid memoizes on their identity.

search.summary: Free-text match across every searchable column.

filter.summary: Apply a typed filter to one column. Operators are constrained by the column's type.

column.description: Column id from the runtime contract.

value2.description: Upper bound; only for the `between` operator.

clearFilters.summary: Remove every column filter and the search text.

sort.summary: Sort by one column, replacing the current sort unless `append` is set.

append.description: Add to the existing sort instead of replacing it.

clearSort.summary: Return to the data's original order.

selectRows.summary: Select or deselect rows by id.

selectAll.summary: Select, or clear, every row matching the current filters.

pinColumn.summary: Pin a column to an edge, or unpin it with a null side.

moveColumn.summary: Move a column before or after another one.

setColumnWidth.summary: Set a column's width in pixels, or null to restore its default.

resetColumns.summary: Restore column order, width, visibility and pinning to their defaults.

setPage.summary: Jump to a page, counting from zero.

setPageSize.summary: Change how many rows a page holds.

export.summary: Download the chosen rows as a file.
export.note: Three formats, three GridApi methods (exportCsv, exportExcel, exportPdf), so no single apiMethod applies.

print.summary: Open the browser's print dialog with the table laid out for paper.

copy.summary: Copy the selected rows to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

undo.summary: Restore the state from before the last operation.
undo.note: Performed by the agent runtime's snapshot history, not by GridApi.

redo.summary: Re-apply the operation that was last undone.
redo.note: Performed by the agent runtime's snapshot history, not by GridApi.

safeMutations.rationale: Presentation is safe to change. `data`/`columns`/`getRowId` are memoization keys — replacing them re-creates the grid model. `mode` and the state callbacks define the client/server contract.

notImplemented: grouping — no API, no state field, no operation
aggregation — no API, no state field, no operation
row-level mutation — no add, delete or set-cell API; editing is a UI affordance only
notIn — a column with fixed options filters by membership only; an exclusion must list the complement
multi-value filter on a plain string column — one column holds one filter
